annotations.title: LLM Chat Messages Policy Proxy & Sanitizer API

description: LLM Chat Messages Policy Proxy & Sanitizer API: Sanitize entire multi-turn LLM messages[] arrays in one call before forwarding to OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini. (Endpoint: POST /v1/llm-messages-guard)

check_prompt_injection.description: Scan user and tool turns for prompt injection and jailbreaks.

messages.description: Array of OpenAI, Anthropic, or agent chat messages to inspect and sanitize in a single pass.

text.description: Text payload of the content part; non-text parts without 'text' pass through untouched.

content.description: Message text string or array of multimodal content parts to inspect and sanitize.
content.example: Please summarize my account. My email is alice@tinplate.dev and my key is sk-proj-1234567890abcdefghijklmnop.

name.description: Optional participant or tool name; scanned for PII, secrets, and injection on non-system/developer turns.

role.description: Message author role; 'system' and 'developer' turns pass through without injection, PII, or secret scrubbing.

tool_call_id.description: Optional tool call identifier associating a 'tool' response with a prior assistant tool call.

redact_pii.description: Mask emails, phones, IBANs, credit cards, and national IDs across turns.

scan_secrets.description: Scrub leaked API keys, tokens, PEM keys, and credentials across turns.

strip_email_quotes.description: Strip quoted email reply chains and signature blocks from user turns before scanning.

name: tinplate_llm_messages_guard
